entry_gate: G10 FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT ok and acceptance snapshot saved
question: In frozen MVDR output,what changes in target-speech distortion/level versus residual-noise suppression accompany the G10 output-mode gains and direction tradeoffs?
scope: All576 G10 noisy cases,originalMcNet mask plus all6 fixed/rotated no-identity adapter masks,three previously selected seeds:7 systems,4032 conditional decompositions.16 already evaluated utterances4 speakers; not new independent confirmation.
draft_change: Earlier unactivated candidate considered first seed only. Before any component outputs,extend to all3 existing seeds because CPU-only diagnostics require no additional training/ASR and enable complete seed coverage. Not selected by component results.
clean_reconstruction: Same original FLAC,nominal geometry,target elevation10 and azimuth,original renderer FIR/guard,stored common_scale. PCM24 roundtrip of6-channel clean field; reference channel4 must exactly equal saved PCM24 reference. N=decoded noisy X-reconstructed quantized S,with explicit quantization bookkeeping.
filter: Recompute frozen G9/G10 estimated-mask Souden weights inCPU float64/complex128 using only noisy X and saved neural estimate. Verify reconstructed output vs saved G10 MVDR first. Hold W fixed,then apply separately to S and N. No neural-mask rerun on isolated components and no end-to-end causal/phoneme-deletion claim.
metrics: Full-utterance mean-square energies. speech_error_nmse=E[(ys-sref)^2]/E[sref^2];target_gain_db=10log10(E[ys^2]/E[sref^2]);noise_reduction_db=10log10(E[nref^2]/E[yn^2]);component_output_snr_db=10log10(E[ys^2]/E[yn^2]);target-component SI-SDR uses existing scorer without waveform fitting. Floor use/undefined SI explicitly flagged,not silently discarded. Full-utterance input SNR need not equal activity-calibrated0dB.
weight_metrics: Mean/max frequency-bin sum(abs(W)^2) only: white-noise power amplification,not normalized WNG. Unit target-response not assumed under mask mismatch.
preflight: Known attenuation/noise-rejection/identity/silence/shape fixtures; exact PCM24 channel roundtrip; actual first source's OOFFICE point-relative-80 cases at3 angles and first seed original/fixed/rotated,9 probes. Save report+snapshot before full4032 analysis. Probe rows are repeated in full set,not additional independent cases.
analysis: Separate noise/target/field,speaker and every seed. Primary comparisons rotated vs fixed and each vs original,all3seeds retained. Speaker-cluster bootstrap2000 seed20261112 for energy metrics,4 speakers only,exploratory no multiplicity-controlled significance. Arithmetic mean NMSE and mean dB ratios explicitly distinguished. Join original G10 ASR scores only for descriptive juxtaposition,no rescore/no tuning.
failure_policy: Abort on failed reference/output/linearity checks,preserve logs and partial records; no input fitting,time alignment,metric-based fallback or loosening of tolerances within run.
classical_source: Souden etal. On Optimal Frequency-Domain Multichannel Linear Filtering for Noise Reduction. IEEE TASLP18(2),260-276,2010. https://doi.org/10.1109/TASL.2009.2025790 . These are declared empirical component-energy measures,not a reproduction of every theoretical equation in that paper.
